hypotheses.claim: No deployed path delivers INTRADAY_DIRECT_ASSIGNED to an SE phone: the row lands in-app only and the app must be opened to see it
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: a real FCM/APNs adapter is bound at runtime by env/config, so the LoggingChannelGateway default never applies in a deployed stack
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rn NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_GATEWAY apps/backend/src — the only useClass binding is LoggingChannelGateway (notifications.module.ts:18); notification-seam.ts:77 actively ASSERTS every channel returns UNAVAILABLE, so a real adapter would fail that assertion

hypotheses.claim: manual-assign persists: the ACCEPTED row + schedule/batch ids survive reload, so the ZM's resolution is not lost on refresh
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: the tx commits the assignment but the ledger update runs on a different connection and silently no-ops for a row another sweep moved first
hypotheses.altCheck: read of override.service.ts:725-745 — the ledger callback takes the same `tx`; P2002 aborts the whole transaction rather than leaving a half-write

hypotheses.claim: zone scoping on GET /intraday-insertions is enforced backend-side, so a ZM cannot read another zone's CRITICAL escalations
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: user.zone_id is null for a ZM whose claim was never stamped, which collapses the where-clause to {} and returns every zone
hypotheses.altCheck: read of listForScope:479-481 — the guard is `role === 'ZONAL_MANAGER' && zoneId != null`; a null zone_id does fall through to the cross-zone branch, which only a token walk can rule out

hypotheses.claim: ASSIGNED_DIRECT rows have no downstream consumer at all — only ESCALATION_REQUIRED reaches the efficiency cube
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: a report or dashboard counts direct assignments through the audit CRITICAL_ASSIGN action instead of the ledger, so the metric exists under another name
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rln intradayInsertion apps/backend/src outside src/intraday — only override.service.ts and dispatch-today-query.service.ts; the cube's SQL at :230 filters status='ESCALATION_REQUIRED' only
